chunks: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, and Ahmad ibn Idris, all of them, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari, from al-Siyari, from al-Hakam ibn Salim, from the one who told him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, we and the family of Abu Sufyan are two households who became enemies for the sake of Allah. We said: 'Allah spoke true', whereas they said: 'Allah lied'. Abu Sufyan fought the Messenger of Allah, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family. Mu'awiya fought Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him. Yazid ibn Mu'awiya fought al-Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, and al-Sufyani will fight the Riser, peace be upon him.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: Al-Sufyani (a specific figure in end-times eschatology)
key_terms.تَعَادَيْنَا فِي اللَّهِ: We became enemies for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the theological reason for the enmity between the Ahl al-Bayt and the Umayyads according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to establish the Umayyads' inherent opposition to the Ahl al-Bayt as a theological reality rather than mere political rivalry, framing their conflict as a struggle between truth (Haqq) and falsehood (Batil). The text explicitly links the historical enmity of Abu Sufyan against the Prophet, Muawiya against Ali, and Yazid against Husayn to the eschatological battle of al-Sufyani against the Mahdi, illustrating a continuous lineage of usurpation. This underscores the Shia view that the Umayyad claim to authority was fundamentally illegitimate from the outset.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, and Ahmad bin Idrees, all of them, from Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Yahya bin Imran al-Ash’ari, from al-Saiyari, from Hakam bin Salem, from the one who told him, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

«Indeed, we and the family of Abu Sufyan are two households who became enemies for the sake of Allah. We said: «Allah spoke true», whereas they said: «Allah lied». Abu Sufyan fought the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family. Mu’awiya fought Ali bin Abi Talib, peace be upon him. Yazid bin Mu’awiya fought Hussain bin Ali, peace be upon them both, and al-Sufyani will fight the Riser, peace be upon him.
